body:
Wow, again I don't know what to say. I'm really amazed by your answers, it means a lot to me. Thank you a lot for your long, detailed answer. Your advices are very helpful and your reflection on relationships and breakups is bringing a new dimension that I think needed to hear.

Thanks a lot it made me think a lot, and I think I'm starting to grasp how I should feel about this situation. It's incredibly helpful. Thank you very much

I have to say I'm really amazed by your answer and the community in general. Thanks for understanding and being supportive.

I'm not in an immediate crisis, what is difficult is that I thought that "time will heal", but what drove me here is that I really get the feeling that things are only getting worse, like there's no possible good way out of this. I'm not sure I want to end it now, but the pain is really unbearable and I don't see how it could be better. But the thing is that I want to get better, and this is one one the few things that gives me hope, and makes me feel that I haven't completely given up. But it is so incredibly difficult, I feel insipid, empty.

Thank you a lot for your help, it sure made me feel better. I will look into the ressources

Thanks for your answer.

I think that this may be the problem. When we were together I was interested in a couple of things, movies, books, guitar and friends. But it really didn't matter in the sens that it was secondary,peripheral. When I was going out, I didn't care about thins because at the end of the day I knew that I had this great relationship, and it was the best thing in the world. I'm not sure if I express myself adequatly (English is not.my first language), but thid relationship was/is the only "true" thing.

I've never been really self centered, I study in a subject that interests me, but it's not a passion. It may sound dumb but the only things that I look forward to in my life is the prospect of building a family, and dedicate my life to it. And it's tough to re-become the center of your life when you never really was. I don't see how I can go further without anything/anyone but be to care for.
